requests.name: community_interior_paintover
requests.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production art-direction paintover of an actual playable Godot Japanese small-town interior. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, not a new layout reference. Preserve the exact high cutaway camera, room outline, all existing main furniture footprints, exit position, walking aisles, player and shopkeeper identity/position. Upgrade it into a coherent Japanese TV anime slice-of-life background: clean confident linework, flat local colours, restrained crisp two-tone shading, golden summer daylight and cool lavender shade. Maintain believable metre scale and practical floor clearance. Do not use photorealism, oily painting, excessive bloom, giant props, UI, captions, watermarks or readable invented text. No ceiling that covers the room. Make visible details that can be built in real 3D, not decorative graphic overlays. Refine the community craft workshop: pale warm plaster, weathered muted honey-pine floor with distinct broad boards and quiet grain, dark aged timber rails. Add two modest real framed side windows high enough to preserve wall-side storage, blue summer courtyard glimpses and slatted sunlight. Keep the existing central worktable and lantern trial beam exactly where they are. Give the table an actual joined plank top, a small neatly placed cutting mat, washi sheets, bamboo-strip work in progress and shallow tool tray. Along the back and side walls group labelled archive boxes, rolled paper, neatly folded indigo and rust fabric, woven baskets and one modest community bulletin with illustrated festival sketches. Existing physical signs stay in their location. A few material bundles and reused repair marks show daily use; the entire centre and trial aisle remain open. Keep the calm generous space, with visual density concentrated around the edges and work surfaces.
